title: 🧹 refactor: reduce useAppState complexity
body:
🎯 **What:** Extracted domain-specific state logic from `useAppState` into separate hooks (`useIdentity`, `useProposals`, `useBallotState`). Updated `useAppState` to compose these hooks and maintain the exact same API signature for consumer components. Fixed some failing test cases in `DatabaseStatusModal.test.tsx` by introducing `waitFor` for async state updates and making sure the `testResult` state correctly resets on modal close.
💡 **Why:** `useAppState.ts` had grown into a monolithic file (600+ lines), managing unrelated domains (Identity, Proposals, Ballots). Extracting these domains into their own hooks greatly improves readability, encapsulation, and maintainability.
✅ **Verification:** Ran `npm run test` and all 58 tests passed successfully (including those in `useAppState.test.ts` and `__tests__/useAppState.test.ts`), confirming no regressions in behavior. Code review passed.
✨ **Result:** The state logic is now properly modularized in `src/hooks`, making it significantly easier to navigate, test, and expand in the future without risk of tightly coupling unrelated state logic.
